records.prompt: Create ONE production raster OVERLAY for a full-art historical playing card. Actual transparent PNG, 63:88 portrait canvas at high resolution. No portrait or scene: upper art window is real alpha transparency. No letters, numbers or symbols anywhere; all information is inserted later. This must be a single coherent illustration with uniform fine detail density, NOT pasted-on UI widgets. Coordinates are percent of canvas. Thin outer perimeter occupying x0–4% and x96–100%, top0–3%, tastefully engraved. TOP LEFT: integrated empty circular cost socket centered x13%,y9.2%, external diameter20% of canvas width; matte dark interior completely empty, subtle thin material rim blends INTO outer frame, not dangling coin. LOWER FULL-WIDTH PANEL: from x3% to97%, y62% to89.5%, an uninterrupted nearly-black matte material field. Its very thin edge flows organically into left and right outer frame. The entire rectangle x8%–92%, y65%–87.5% must be absolutely plain, evenly dark, flat and unobstructed for dynamic name/role/rules lettering. No divider lines at all inside this rectangle; no central ornaments, no decorative tips, no flourishes, no glints. Do not draw a rounded gold web-form text box. FOOTER: built into lower frame, an empty dark horizontal combat-stat compartment from x3.5% to41.5%,y90%–98.5%, with the entire x5%–39%,y91%–97% dark and blank; no internal divider. At exact bottom center x50%,y94.8%, integrate an EMPTY flat circular icon socket diameter14% canvas width, thin rim; NO crest, no heraldry, no pictorial emblem in this socket. Bottom-right remains artwork/ornament only. No text of any sort. All three sockets and broad information panel are part of the SAME house-specific engraved craftwork; identical placement and generous clear interiors, no isolated generic gold fittings. Restraint: no ornament within any blank data field. Full bleed image will show THROUGH large transparent upper 62% art window. Avoid gradients, haze, rainbow/pastel palette, black opaque art window, checkerboard painted into pixels. HOUSE THEME: HOUSE OF ALBA. Dark slate and weathered SILVER, authentic insular manuscript interlace, a few spare carved thistle leaves confined to external corners. Lower information field dark charcoal slate with very subtle fine grain; fine silver engraved boundary at outer sides, no gold anywhere. Quiet, imposing craftsmanship with readable uninterrupted negative space.
